text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...
Haa......

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "Demon Pace" explodes into action!!
Taking first place is Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Taishin! Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the deafening roar of the cheers,
I still heard her calling out to me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaping over the fence, I found myself running over before I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...I finally get it.
Now, I truly understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not because this is all I have.
It's not because there's nothing else—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I want this.
I want to race...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I...! I want to win races...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And for a while, amidst the cheers,
I shared in the joy with Narita Taishin,
our resolve renewed once more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, about our next target race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...The Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide
said they're aiming for that next.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, at the 'Kikuka Sho',
I couldn't run on equal terms with them at all."
choice_data_list: I see, time for revenge then!
I see, time for payback, huh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Hearing it put like that sounds suffocating and annoying, but yeah, pretty much."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Please take care of the adjustments, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, with renewed resolve, we set our sights on the Tenno Sho (Spring) with Narita Taishin!
